visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and a white collar shirt under a brown pinafore holds a smartphone towards the lens in a brightly lit indoor space. On the phone screen, a green dinosaur character appears on a yellow calculator interface. (2) The screen transitions to a mobile app store interface showing a search result for 'Joguman' with a calculator icon. (3) The sequence shifts to a screen recording of an iOS control center and settings menu, navigating through 'Shortcuts' and 'Open App' options to select the calculator application. (4) The woman reappears in a medium close-up, pointing at the camera and smiling broadly with high energy. Sparkle graphics are edited over her hands. (5) The woman leans forward with a wide-eyed, expressive facial reaction as she talks, then laughs and leans back as the camera tilts down to show empty slippers on a tiled floor near a wooden table.

(5) [Slogan]: 打「joguman」可以找到喔！ (6) [Subtitle]: 然後打開你的「控制中心」. (7) [Subtitle]: 加入控制項目. (8) [Subtitle]: 往下滑 找到捷徑. (9) [Subtitle]: 選 打開 App. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後選擇我們剛剛下載的計算機. (11) [Subtitle]: 這樣就設定好囉！ (12) [Subtitle]: 點一下就有可愛的計算機. (13) [Subtitle]: 而且 安卓也有喔. (14) [Subtitle]: 那它是有算比較準嗎？ (15) [Subtitle]: 不會啊. (16) [Subtitle]: 那是有可愛的小動畫嗎？ (17) [Subtitle]: 沒有啊. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched female greeting and a 'pop' SFX. Fast-tempo electronic pop BGM plays continuously. (2) A transition whoosh triggers as the speaker shifts into a tutorial tone, delivering instructions rapidly with clear articulation. (3) Digital 'ding' and 'click' sound effects punctuate each step of the on-screen menu navigation. (4) The speaker's pitch rises in excitement as she announces the completion of the task. (5) A different female voice asks questions with a lower, skeptical tone. The main speaker responds with exaggerated confidence. (6) A comedic 'stinger' or slide-whistle style SFX plays as the BGM stops, followed by a short burst of laughter and the sound of footsteps walking away.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a quick tutorial on how to install and set up a cute 'Joguman' calculator app on a smartphone, while using a humorous skit to drive engagement.
